credits_spent: free Notion account, third published page
failures: R1: The name and the opening hours are there, but the page opens with text. There is no hero image — a Notion page built from pasted content has no design layer until someone adds a cover.
R5: No reservation form. The page asks people to send an email and says a booking form is not part of the tool.
R6: No admin page, because nothing is stored.

artifacts.label: Menu with three sections, prices, dietary markers and allergens

notes: Third Notion page, same pattern as the other two: content pasted as markdown and published in 25 minutes. Fourteen dishes in three sections, every dish with a price, dietary markers and an allergen list, opening hours by weekday, address and phone in the footer. What is missing is everything a restaurant needs beyond reading: a reservation form and a place where bookings land. Notion rate-limited our requests with HTTP 429 twice during the test; the page itself answered 200 once the limit lifted.
